title: Launch clip: one happy app
caption: Everything for family life in Amsterdam, in one happy app. What to do this weekend, where to eat with the kids, which club, who babysits. 1,112 food spots, 1,265 playgrounds, 310 schools, 1,844 clubs, all curated by parents, in English and Dutch, no ads. Free in the App Store and Google Play. Comment PLAN and we send you the link. AF6
first_comment: Alles voor het gezinsleven in Amsterdam, in een app. Wat doen we dit weekend, waar eten we met de kids, welke club, wie past op. Gratis in de App Store en Google Play. Reageer PLAN en we sturen je de link.
feedback: Screen recording, 15 to 20 seconds, a hand holding the phone. Shot 1 home screen and the Dailies card, shot 2 Family Food Spots map zoom into Zuid, shot 3 Top 100 and a save tap. On screen text in three lines as on the cover. Original audio or a cleared track. Cover = this image. Posted the launch day, boosted Sunday if it wins.

title: This week in Amsterdam (events story)
caption: This week in Amsterdam, picked from the Event Agenda. Tap for times, prices and the map. AF1
first_comment: Deze week in Amsterdam, uit de Event Agenda. Tik voor tijden, prijzen en de kaart.
feedback: Story, 3 to 5 frames. Frame 1 = this overview, then one frame per event with a link sticker to the event in the app. Fill the four rows from ams_events for the coming week (the app's Event Agenda page shows the same list). Same layout every Monday, only the rows change.

title: Rainy Wednesday, sorted (theme post)
caption: Rainy Wednesday, sorted. Three places where the coffee is good and the kids are busy: Kinderkookkafé in West (they cook, you sit), Noorderlicht in Noord (space to run, sand to dig), and a third one you tell us in the comments. All 1,112 food spots have a play area filter in the app. AF5
first_comment: Regenachtige woensdag, geregeld. Drie plekken met goede koffie en drukke kinderen. Alle 1.112 eetplekken hebben een speelhoekfilter in de app.
feedback: Multi-image post, 3 to 4 images: this cover, then one photo per place with the name on the image (your photos or the venue's with permission). Tag the venues and invite one as collaborator. KPI is saves, so the last slide says: save this for the next rainy day.

title: New in the app: babysitters (services story)
caption: New in the app this week: the Babysitter Finder. Trusted sitters, contacted direct, no agency, no commission. Plus 12 after school clubs added in Oost. AF2
first_comment: Nieuw in de app deze week: de Babysitter Finder. Betrouwbare oppassers, direct contact, geen bureau, geen commissie.
feedback: Story, 2 to 3 frames: this frame, then a screenshot of one sitter profile (name hidden) with a link sticker, then the after school list for Oost. Tag the new clubs so they reshare (that becomes AF8). Every Thursday, same frame, new items.

title: Places reel: 1,265 playgrounds, this one has a hideout
caption: 1,265 playgrounds in the app. This one has a hideout, a zipline and a coffee cart within shouting distance. Name, ages and the parking tip are in the app under playgrounds, filter by stadsdeel. Which one should we film next? AF4
first_comment: 1.265 speeltuinen in de app. Deze heeft een hut, een kabelbaan en koffie op roepafstand. Welke moeten we hierna filmen?
feedback: Reel, 15 to 25 seconds, phone footage. Shot 1 arriving (bike, gate), shot 2 kids on the thing (zipline or hideout), shot 3 the detail parents miss (the coffee cart, the toilet, the shade). Text on screen: place name, age range, one tip. Pick a Top 100 playground, geotag it, invite the venue or park account as collaborator if it has one.

title: Mom-Manager 01 (collab carousel cover)
caption: Meet [name], who runs Zuid like a company. Two kids, one calendar, zero agencies. Her week, her tricks, and the three places she would never give up. Swipe. Posted together with @[her handle]. AF3
first_comment: Dit is [naam], die Zuid runt als een bedrijf. Twee kinderen, een agenda, nul bureaus. Haar week, haar trucs en de drie plekken die ze nooit opgeeft.
feedback: Carousel, 7 slides: this cover with her portrait, slide 2 her week in one image, slides 3 to 5 her three places (one per slide, from the app), slide 6 her best trick as a quote, slide 7 the ask: who should we feature next. Invite her as collaborator, post Sunday 19:00, she reshares to stories. First candidate from the Accounts tab, status agreed.

title: Under 3s, free afternoons (theme post)
caption: Under 3s, free afternoons. Four places that cost nothing and end in a nap: the Saturday park (any of the 1,265), the library story hour, the petting farm in your stadsdeel, and the market where the cheese man hands out samples. All in the app, filter free and ages 0 to 3. Save it for the next long afternoon. AF5
first_comment: Onder de 3, gratis middagen. Vier plekken die niets kosten en eindigen in een dutje. Allemaal in de app, filter gratis en 0 tot 3 jaar.
feedback: Multi-image, 4 to 5 images: cover plus one per place with the name on the image. Real photos from your own afternoons work best here, the polaroid look is the brand. Tag the farm and the library, both reshare.

title: Places reel: Saturday = park day
caption: Saturday = park day. Amsterdamse Bos edition: the goat farm, the pancake house, the climbing forest, the pedal boats. One entry in the app, four things to do, parking and pram tips included. Comment PLAN and we send you the link. AF4
first_comment: Zaterdag = parkdag. Amsterdamse Bos editie: de geitenboerderij, het pannenkoekenhuis, het klimbos, de waterfietsen. Reageer PLAN en we sturen je de link.
feedback: Reel, 20 to 25 seconds, four quick scenes (5 s each) with the name of each spot on screen, then the app entry as the last frame. Geotag Amsterdamse Bos. Comment to DM trick: reply to every PLAN comment with the smart link.

title: Feature clip: Dinner Sorted, this fridge has nothing in it
caption: This fridge has nothing in it. Half a cucumber, three eggs, a yoghurt and hope. Snap it, three recipes appear, kids approved, dinner in 20 minutes. Dinner Sorted lives in the app, Little Chef for when they choose, Fridge Rescue for when you cannot. Insider, 1 euro a week, nobody paid to be recommended. Comment FRIDGE and we send you the link. AF6
first_comment: Deze koelkast is leeg. Een halve komkommer, drie eieren, een yoghurt en hoop. Maak een foto, drie recepten, eten in 20 minuten. Eten Geregeld zit in de app. Reageer FRIDGE en we sturen je de link.
feedback: The organic twin of the paid Fridge Rescue angle, one gesture: open the fridge at 17:45, snap, three recipes, cut to a kid eating. 10 to 15 seconds, phone shot, real fridge, real kid. On screen line as on the cover. Never say AI, say Dinner Sorted. Same reel doubles as the AD4 creative with the price line added. Second AF6 of the month.

title: Real parent testimonial 01
caption: One question, one parent, twenty seconds: what did the app do for you this month? [Her answer in her words.] Not scripted, we just pressed record. What would you say? AF7
first_comment: Een vraag, een ouder, twintig seconden: wat heeft de app deze maand voor je gedaan. Niet geregisseerd, we drukten op opnemen.
feedback: Reel, 20 seconds, phone, natural light, subtitles burned in. Ask one question and let her talk. No app screens in the video, her face and her words carry it. Cover = this frame with her real quote. Ask a question in the caption so people answer in the comments (KPI comments).

title: Partner badge wave (badge design pending)
caption: Proud to be in the Amsterdam Families app. [Partner posts this; we reshare to stories the same day and thank them by DM.] AF8
first_comment: Trots om in de Amsterdam Families app te staan.
feedback: Not a post you make, a frame partners post. The badge design is pending (must be something a venue is proud to post, not a 'find us' label). This placeholder shows the layout: their photo, the badge, their category. Send with the partner wave mail from the Campaigns tab. You reshare every one.

title: Birthday party without the panic (theme post)
caption: Birthday party without the panic. 225 entries in the Birthday Directory: 59 entertainers, 166 party venues, filter by age, stadsdeel and budget. Three combos that always work: the pancake boat, the climbing hall plus pizza, the magician at home. Save it for the next 'mama, my party'. AF5
first_comment: Kinderfeestje zonder paniek. 225 adressen in de Birthday Directory: 59 entertainers, 166 feestlocaties, filter op leeftijd, stadsdeel en budget.
feedback: Multi-image, 4 images: cover, three combos with a photo each (venue photos with permission or your own). Tag the venues, invite one as collaborator. Good candidate for the giveaway later: one venue gifts a party slot.

title: Ad: Which Amsterdam family are you?
caption: Every Amsterdam family has a type. Ours is Rainy Day Rebels. What is yours? Take the 60 second test, get 20 weekend plans that fit your actual family. Free quiz, the full result lives in the app, Insider 0.99 a week.
first_comment: Elk Amsterdams gezin heeft een type. Wij zijn Rainy Day Rebels. Welk gezin zijn jullie? Doe de test van 60 seconden.
feedback: Story ad 1080x1920 from the campaign visuals. Points to amsterdamfamilies.com/quiz, never to the store. Four creatives per angle: this one, a phone shot of a family biking in the rain, the result card, a founder face version. Review every 7 days.

title: Ad: Our Family Food Map
caption: Where do we all actually enjoy lunch? Not just the kids. Not just you. All of us. Six questions, fifteen places where nobody ends up under the table. Written by parents, not by the restaurant.
first_comment: Waar lunchen we nou echt allemaal lekker? Zes vragen, vijftien plekken waar niemand onder de tafel belandt.
feedback: Story ad from the campaign visuals. Second quiz, week 6 to 8. Reward: 15 matching spots on the map with parent notes, refreshed each season for members.

title: Ad: Parent Battery Check
caption: Your weekend brain is at 12 percent. Plug in. How many tabs are open in your head right now? Seven questions, one battery percentage, one recharge plan.
first_comment: Je weekendbrein zit op 12 procent. Hoeveel tabbladen staan er open in je hoofd? Zeven vragen, een percentage, een oplaadplan.
feedback: Story ad from the campaign visuals. The funny one. Result card built to be posted: my battery is at 23 percent, what is yours. Can replace AD2 as the second quiz if the family type wins fast.

title: Ad: Fridge Rescue
caption: Show me your fridge and I will tell you what your kids eat tonight. Half a cucumber, three eggs, a yoghurt. Snap it. Dinner in 20 minutes. Fridge Rescue is part of Dinner Sorted in the app, 0.99 a week.
first_comment: Laat je koelkast zien en ik zeg wat je kinderen vanavond eten. Een foto, eten in 20 minuten.
feedback: Story ad from the campaign visuals. Not a quiz, a 10 to 15 second reel: the sad fridge at 17:45, snap, three recipes, kid eating. Film four fridges (Sunday evening, back from holiday, grandparents were here, delivery did not come). The organic twin is the AF6 Dinner Sorted concept.

title: Ad: Birthday Panic
caption: Oh no. Their birthday is in three weeks. Twelve kids, one afternoon, zero tears (yours). 225 ways to save a birthday, none of them paid to be on the list. From panic to plan before the school run ends.
first_comment: O nee. Over drie weken is het feestje. Twaalf kinderen, een middag, nul tranen (die van jou). 225 manieren om een feestje te redden.
feedback: Story ad from the campaign visuals plus search: kinderfeestje Amsterdam, birthday party venue Amsterdam kids, goochelaar kinderfeestje Amsterdam on Apple Ads and Google. Seasonal pushes January, May, September. KPI: cost per Insider from search vs Meta (bar 3x cheaper).
